name: Moz Pro
tagline: Moz Pro is a comprehensive SEO toolkit that combines keyword research, site audits, rank tracking, and backlink analysis with AI-powered recommendations. Its MozBar Chrome extension shows SEO metrics on any page. Moz's Domain Authority metric is one of the most widely referenced SEO benchmarks in the industry.
